+    def _quantize_error(self, quantized):
+        # Mean square error between this image and a quantized version of it,
+        # averaged over all bands
+        from . import ImagePalette
+
+        mode = quantized.im.getpalettemode()
+        quantized.palette = ImagePalette.ImagePalette(
+            mode, quantized.im.getpalette(mode, mode)
+        )
+        restored = quantized.convert(self.mode)
+        total = 0
+        for original_band, restored_band in zip(self.split(), restored.split()):
+            diff = original_band.im.chop_difference(restored_band.im)
+            histogram = diff.histogram()
+            total += sum(i * i * count for i, count in enumerate(histogram))
+        return total / (self.width * self.height * len(self.getbands()))
+
+    def _adjust_palette_lightness(self, lightness_factor):
+        # Scale the color channels of each palette entry, leaving any alpha
+        # channel untouched, and clamp the results to 0-255.
+        from . import ImagePalette
+
+        mode = self.im.getpalettemode()
+        data = bytearray(self.im.getpalette(mode, mode))
+        channels = len(mode)
+        for i in range(len(data)):
+            if mode == "RGBA" and i % channels == 3:
+                continue
+            data[i] = max(0, min(255, int(round(data[i] * lightness_factor))))
+        data = bytes(data)
+        if mode == "RGBA":
+            self.im.putpalette("RGBX", data)
+            self.im.putpalettealphas(data[3::4])
+        else:
+            self.im.putpalette(mode, data)
+        self.palette = ImagePalette.ImagePalette(mode, data)
